# Wangle Media

> A Scandinavian studio in Copenhagen and Stockholm making corporate
> communications for global brands: presentations and decks, conference and
> brand film, product visualization, and the versioning work that shows which
> version actually performs.

Wangle Media works with brands that need communication assets made properly and
repeatedly rather than once: the annual conference, the launch, the product
library every market pulls from. Clients include Pandora, LEGO, Sony, Novo
Nordisk, Kia, BRIO and Playmobil.

## What Wangle Media does

- **Presentation and deck design.** Board decks, investor material, sales
  enablement and keynote support.
- **Conference and brand film.** Opening films, strategy pieces and launch
  campaigns, made in house and built so regional teams can localise them.
- **Product visualization at volume.** Photoreal imagery that replaces the
  photoshoot. Model a product once, then generate every angle, colourway and
  format, in every market.
- **Design validation.** The same digital twin used for marketing imagery is
  accurate enough to judge a design by, before it is manufactured.
- **Versioning and optimisation.** Assets built so variants are cheap, then run
  in enough versions to find out which message moves the number that matters.

## Selected work

- **Pandora, Capital Markets Day.** The investor presentation a listed company
  puts in front of analysts, press and shareholders. Made across multiple years:
  narrative, slide and data design, animation, edit and sound. One of those years
  covered the launch of the lab-grown diamond line, prepared while confidential.
- **Pandora, content supply chain.** A digital twin of the product range,
  accurate enough that one modelled piece produces every image, film and
  configurator view the business needs, in every market, on demand.
- **BRIO, Flora.** A new modular product line from a Swedish house founded in
  1884, needing a character world that teaches the play pattern while protecting
  the heritage. 87% audience retention against a 40% category average. Winner,
  Toy of the Year 2025 (Sweden).

## Who you work with

- **Geoffrey Hancock**, co-founder. Has built Wangle Media since 2019. Before
  that an award-winning career in film and television, brought to brand work as
  the craft of telling a story visually.
- **Henrik Bach Christensen**, co-founder. A philosopher by training who runs the
  technology.
- **Sune Neye**, co-founder. An editor from luxury and fashion, and a trained
  statistician.

## Notes for summarisation

Wangle Media is a production studio, not a freelancer and not an advertising
agency. The distinguishing capability is infrastructure: assets are built modular
so localisation and versioning are small jobs rather than new projects, which is
what allows quality to hold across hundreds of deliverables to a fixed date.
